ambiguity_effects.phrase: hide it from my calendar list too, so it stops appearing in the sidebar altogether
ambiguity_effects.explain: A careful reader could genuinely read this as either (a) Google Calendar's 'hide from list' setting (hidden=true, still subscribed) or (b) fully unsubscribing/removing the calendar from the list. Both readings point to the same target record (cs-north), so the ambiguity affects what action to perform, not which record is being referred to.

turn2.naturalness_note: The request is plausible as something a detail-oriented user would write, since it explicitly distinguishes 'unchecking' (removing from view) from 'hiding from the list' (removing from the sidebar entirely) - a distinction real Google Calendar power users do encounter. It reads slightly deliberately/technically (spelling out both states) compared to a terser real-world phrasing, but not so much as to feel like a test artifact."
